glossary.definition: (A) "Bylaws" means those bylaws established by the interstate commission for its governance or for directing or controlling its actions or conduct.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (B) "Compact administrator" means the individual in each compacting state appointed pursuant to the terms of this compact who is responsible for the administration and management of the state's supervision and transfer of juveniles subject to the terms of this compact, the rules adopted by the interstate commission under this compact, and policies adopted by the state council under this compact.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (C) "Compacting state" means any state that has enacted the enabling legislation for this compact.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (D) "Commissioner" means the voting representative of each compacting state appointed pursuant to Article III of this compact.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (E) "Court" means any court having jurisdiction over delinquent, neglected, or dependent children.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (F) "Interstate commission for juveniles" or "interstate commission" means the interstate commission for juveniles created by Article III of this compact.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (F) "Interstate commission for juveniles" or "interstate commission" means the interstate commission for juveniles created by Article III of this compact.

As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (H) "Noncompacting state" means any state that has not enacted the enabling legislation for this compact.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (I) "Probation or parole" means any kind of supervision or conditional release of juveniles authorized under the laws of the compacting states.
glossary.scope: As used in this compact, unless the context clearly requires a different construction:

glossary.definition: (J) "Rule" means a written statement by the interstate commission promulgated pursuant to Article VI of this compact that is of general applicability, that implements, interprets, or prescribes a policy or provision of the compact, or an organizational, procedural, or practice requirement of the interstate commission, and that has the force and effect of statutory law in a compacting state, and includes the amendment, repeal, or suspension of an existing rule.
